_README: Group 3 UI field-observation view. Every value is read from the canonical record produced by integration/emit_canonical_observation.py. Nothing here is hand-entered.

quality_status.meaning: field QA verdict about the observation itself

pipeline_status.meaning: how far the observation has travelled through VANA
pipeline_status.deliberately_not_in_contract: Adding it would break the V1.0 freeze and would conflate a QA verdict with a transport position. An observation can be UNCERTAIN and CANONICAL at the same time; both are true.

_status_derivation.honest_caveat: CANONICAL here means the observation reached a canonical record built from Group 1's SCHEMA on a LOCAL database. It has NOT reached Group 1's instance, and it did NOT cross the edge transport - SVACS is blocked. The UI must not imply otherwise.

device.note: Device identifier only. No Group 3 device has produced a recorded reading.

raw_artifact.note: Reference only - the raw file is not transmitted to the canonical store.

origin_banner.label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - NOT A HARDWARE OBSERVATION
origin_banner.display_rule: MUST be shown prominently and MUST NOT be dismissible while is_synthetic is true. A synthetic observation rendered like a real one is the failure mode this banner exists to prevent.
